name: mu_cep
label: mu Cephei (Herschel's Garnet Star, M2 Ia)
sources: Perrin et al. 2005, A&A 436, 317: photospheric diameter 14.11 +/- 0.6 mas (K band); Wiesemeyer et al. 2026: 16.85 +/- 0.15 mas; Mozurkewich et al. 2003: 20.6 mas limb-darkened at 800 nm, since shown to be the molecular layer
Wiesemeyer et al. 2026: distance 421 (+57/-42) pc, T_eff 3800 K, mass 11 Msun (Josselin & Plez 2007: 3750 K)
Ducati 2002: V 4.08 (variable 3.4-5.1), H -1.27, K -1.72; Gaia DR3 coordinates
notes: First null 16.2 m at 900 nm, 11.7 m at 650 nm; at 650 nm the molecular layer (~20 mas) rather than the photosphere may set the size -- exactly the 650 vs 900 nm comparison the ISI filters make.
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets (V +0.02, H +1.39, K +1.85); 900 and 900 nm fall inside the anchored range.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. No NewEra model exists below 4700 K: blackbody + linear law.
